purge: Exclude label windows ending on or after the next year boundary
selection: Greatest 2023 average precision; smaller C breaks ties
calibration: Sigmoid fitted to selected model logits and 2023 labels; no model refit
ties: Score descending, cell_id ascending; independent of labels
cohort: Fixed cells with finite nonnegative population; identical for all methods
exposure: WorldPop 2020 persons per cell; never a predictor

bootstrap.method: Paired circular moving-block resampling of weeks
bootstrap.statistic: Pooled population-weighted recall difference at K=50

limitations: Retrospective reanalysis ranking; operational FWI publication lag and live access are unverified
FWI weather pixels are coarser than the 10 km decision grid
Negative label means no qualifying satellite detection, not absence of fire
Population is a fixed exposure proxy, not people harmed or losses prevented
2023 is used for both model selection and calibration; only 2024 is held out
One province, one test year; temporal bootstrap does not establish generalization or causal benefit
